name: Univerbal
long_description:
Univerbal is an AI-powered language learning app that helps people boost their confidence simply by talking. In unscripted and dynamic conversations, users can talk about anything they’d like using the microphone, with the AI responding as it adapts to their level and skills. Each user gets a personal AI Language Tutor that creates a custom learning plan based on the language goals they’d like to work towards and their own interests, offers instant corrections after every message and helps users in their own language.
Based in the country with 4 official languages, Switzerland, in 2024 we were selected as one of WIRED’s Hottest 100 Startups in Europe.
one_liner: Language learning with a conversational AI Tutor

app_answers.question: Describe what your company does in 50 characters or less.
app_answers.answer: Conversational language practice by talking to AI

app_answers.question: What is your company going to make? Please describe your product and what it does or will do.
app_answers.answer:
It's a language learner chatbot app that teaches people conversational fluency in a foreign language. In dynamic and unscripted conversations with an LLM-based AI users can practice their language skills. Learners record themselves saying something and the AI responds in turn, just like in a conversation with a human. 

With the scene builder, learners can customize what they want to talk about by filling in the blanks: "I want to talk about CHESS with A GRAND MASTER in A HOTEL LOBBY while roleplaying A NOVICE CHESSPLAYER". Thus learners can exactly tailor the scene to their desires.

We also offer predefined scenes which focus on different areas of vocabulary useful to learners (e.g. getting to know someone, public transportation, etc). Additionally, in every scene, users can analyze the grammar of their responses or use hints to help them out when they get stuck.

Obviously, there is more to it but it's easiest if you just try our beta yourself at talk.quazel.com

founders.founder_bio: Philipp has a deep technical background from his Computer Science undergraduate degree from ETH Zurich and his graduate research experience on NLP at UC Berkeley. Wanting to learn Greek, he took 1-1 tutoring lessons and noticed how tailoring a session based completely on the student's interest and need can drastically accelerate learning as well as be more engaging.

launches.title: Univerbal - AI Language Learning App
launches.tagline: We help language learners boost their confidence & get fluent fast by practicing with AI.
launches.body:
## **TL;DR: Language learning that’s as unique as you are.**

If you’ve ever learnt a language, you’ve probably spent hours memorizing vocabulary or doing infinite grammar exercises only to then realize you can’t really… speak the language.

The [Univerbal](https://univerbal.app/) app helps you get confident to speak by practicing with real-life, open conversations with an AI conversation partner that adapts to your answers and your level. Most importantly, never judges you!

Your personal AI Tutor creates a language study plan combining both the language skills you’d like to work towards, based on CEFR language education standards and the conversation topics you’re interested in. **_No two study plans are the same because no two language learning journeys are the same._**

### **Try it for free:**

🌐 [Web app](http://chat.univerbal.app/) | 🍎 [Get the iOS app](http://univerbal.app/) | 🤖 [Get the Android app](http://univerbal.app/)

Watch the demo [here](https://youtu.be/gZs_F9J76xg) and try the app for free.

### 

## **🤔 The problem**

People learn a language to be able to speak it, but they end up memorizing vocabulary and doing boring grammar exercises and in the process, forget or they get too shy to actually practice speaking

Practicing with native speakers can feel like a burden, language tutors can soon get expensive and using some language apps can only get you so far.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=85531&key=user_uploads/566264/8a04773c-911c-4f8d-bbdd-392e51ee0f0b)

## **💡 The solution**

We’re based in Switzerland: the country with 4 official languages🇨🇭 so it was only natural to try to solve this problem by building an AI-powered language learning app to help everyone increase their confidence to speak a new language.

Univerbal was born out of our own frustration as language learners (initially Philipp’s as he was learning Greek to connect to his Cypriot family heritage). It was obvious that the only way to get better was to speak, but it became both difficult to find the time for tutor sessions and very expensive 💸

Univerbal gives everyone access to a conversation partner and language tutor that’s customized to their own needs.

## **👉 How does it work?**

With the Univerbal app, each user gets a personal AI Language Tutor that creates a study plan based on the language goals they wants to work towards **and** the topics they’re interested in talking about.

Developed in collaboration with the Language Department at the University of Zürich, this ensures that everyone gets the language training based on CEFR language education standards, that’s also personalized to their own needs, skills and interests!

No two study plans are the same.

Users can practice with real-life conversations like ordering coffee or going for a job interview, get help from their AI Language Tutor in their own language and practice with short vocabulary exercises.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=85531&key=user_uploads/566264/3a215c8e-39e0-4e0d-85fa-13e7e11b1d9e)

## **👋 Ask**

* **We need your input:** What would you like to see in terms of vocabulary features? What’s helped you in the past as a language learner? Speaking is essential, but we don’t want to neglect vocabulary building.
* Offer: 30% off on the 3M and 12M plan with code STUDYPLAN at this link [Univerbal](https://chat.univerbal.app/)
* Try it and leave us feedback: 🌐 [Web app](http://chat.univerbal.app/) | 🍎 [Get the iOS app](http://univerbal.app/) | 🤖 [Get the Android app](http://univerbal.app/)
* Join us on [Discord](https://discord.gg/EpbYsNKNy9) or follow us on [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/univerbalapp/)
* Spread the word to other language lovers

launches.tagline: A brand new name, look and feel
launches.body:
# **Quazel is now Univerbal.**

### A brand new name, look, and features for your AI-Language Tutor.

\
When we launched [Quazel](https://www.ycombinator.com/launches/HuS-quazel-talk-your-way-to-fluency) we focused on building the best AI Language Tutor app out there.

Lots of people tried it and loved it, except _everyone struggled to spell it… or find it._

Quazel makes sense in German, as a play on _quasseln_ (to chat), but that’s about it. And, as a language learning app, **we wanted to be uni…versal**, after all - so we needed a name to reflect that.

**Introducing - Univerbal!** A brand new name, look, and feel for the AI Tutor in your pocket. With lots of new features, too.

### **Try it for free:**

🌐 [Web app (no account needed)](http://chat.univerbal.app/) | 🍎 [Get the iOS app](https://apps.apple.com/ch/app/univerbal/id6443595452) | 🤖 [Get the Android app](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.chatexpo&hl=en&gl=US)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=77959&key=user_uploads/566264/e21383c2-8971-43f2-b847-eeb841231f54)

The AI Tutor that helps anyone learn a language by talking freely, with no judgment, through conversations personalized to your interests.

\
🎙️ Talk about anything you’d like and practice with real-life scenarios \
✍️ Get instant feedback from your AI Tutor

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=77959&key=user_uploads/566264/e75e59bf-d29f-4317-a864-78a9adcaad13)

**NEW:**\
✔️ Work towards mastering language skills

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=77959&key=user_uploads/566264/2f5a8178-9d64-40db-8a18-b6147f3e4ae7)

💫 Generate an infinite amount of possible conversations based on your interests and skill progress

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=77959&key=user_uploads/566264/df14f1df-680c-44d2-893f-a3d2960bdb31)

🧑‍🏫 Switch to tutor mode any time and ask questions in your known language\
👩 Get a photorealistic image of your AI conversation partner\
🤝 Guided beginner mode\
\
Of course, Quazel OGs get a badge!

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=77959&key=user_uploads/566264/1e28b9e3-369f-4a77-9f81-756fceb91778)

## **👋 Ask:**

* **We need your input:** How much gamification do you think we should add? On the one hand, we don’t want to become a “game” and a Tutor lesson is always a “hard” thing and kind of exhausting, but there is some balance to be struck there. Thoughts?
* Try it here and leave us feedback
* Join us on [Discord](https://discord.gg/QeZuJyCg)) or follow us on [social](https://www.instagram.com/univerbal_app/)
* Spread the word to other language lovers

launches.title: Quazel - Talk your way to fluency
launches.tagline: An AI language tutor in your pocket
launches.body:
David, Sam, and I (Philipp) have been hard at work to build [Quazel](https://quazel.com), a language learning app that enables users to have natural and unscripted conversations with an AI tutor.

[🌐Try it (no account needed)](https://quazel.com/try) | 🍎Get the [iOS app](https://apps.apple.com/qa/app/quazel/id6443595452?platform=iphone) | 🤖 Android app is pending review.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=68848&key=user_uploads/566264/c070ce58-86ac-49bc-9b11-4ccffab650fe)

**Problem**\
Right now, conversational practice gets neglected, and boring grammar and vocabulary are emphasized too much! Additionally, tailored tutoring is too expensive, cumbersome to schedule and beginners are often self-conscious about the way they talk.

_Background_

I faced the problem of exact issue a while ago when I started to learn Greek and thought to myself there must be a better way! To be honest, I really want Quazel for myself but seeing that other people really like it is the cherry on top 😄.

\
**Solution**\
With Quazel learners are thrown into real-world scenarios where they actually need to talk. Speak into the mic & listen to AI responses. Features include:

* Scene Builder - Create your own scenes & get an AI-generated image of your conversation partner!
* Grammar Analysis
* Built-in translator
* …much more

\
**Ask:** [Try it](https://quazel.com/try)! Leave us some feedback and report bugs! 🙌
